attributes.readMe:
## Record Owner (RO)

Owner (id+name), team, since, provenance (assigned / claimed / round-robin / escalation) and one hop of trail. Written ONLY by the Assign Owner command so reassignment always leaves a trace. FieldDefs cannot `linksTo`, so the owner is stored as id+display and the command resolves.

### Non-goals

Not an ACL and not a full history — the timeline owns the trail beyond one hop.
